main.description: A user's ATTrails profile. Unlike the throwaway app.attrails.v0.* records, this NSID is unversioned and durable; the existence of this record is the signal that an account is an ATTrails user.

name.description: Display name. Must not be empty; the AppView rejects records with an empty name (lexicon has no minLength, so this cannot be expressed in-schema).

profilePicture.description: Profile picture. Upload with an image/* Content-Type. maxSize matches app.attrails.v0.defs#image (1MB).
